Tenant in Situ | Approx. 10.5% Gross Yield | Grade II Listed Waterfront Apartment
Pease Court, High Street, Hull, HU1
An outstanding opportunity to acquire a fully let investment property within one of Hulls most distinctive Grade II Listed waterfront developments.

For August only, this superb investment is available at the special price of £59,950.

Situated within the highly sought-after Pease Court, a beautifully converted 18th Century warehouse overlooking the River Hull, this well-presented apartment is sold with a tenant in situ, currently generating £525 PCM (£6,300 per annum), providing an attractive gross rental yield of approximately 10.5% based on the promotional asking price.

Offering approximately 24m² (258 sq ft) of well-designed accommodation, the apartment features a bright open-plan living space with characterful exposed beams, a modern fitted kitchen and a contemporary shower room. The development also benefits from beautifully maintained communal gardens, creating a peaceful setting in the heart of Hulls historic Old Town.

With a share of the freehold, approximately 987 years remaining on the lease, no ground rent, and an established tenant already in place, this property offers investors immediate rental income from completion.

Location
Perfectly positioned on Hulls historic High Street, Pease Court enjoys a prime waterfront setting just a short stroll from the vibrant Fruit Market, Hull Marina, Humber Street and the Museums Quarter. The area offers an excellent selection of independent cafés, restaurants, galleries and bars, while Hull Paragon Interchange, St Stephens Shopping Centre and Hull city centre are all within easy walking distance.

This sought-after location continues to attract strong rental demand, making it an excellent choice for investors seeking a low-maintenance city centre investment.

Whether youre an experienced landlord looking to expand your portfolio or purchasing your first buy-to-let property, this ready-made investment offers immediate rental income, excellent lease terms and an enviable waterfront location.
